description:
Future group is in talks with veteran industrialist Mukesh Ambani's company Reliance Industries to sell stakes in its company Future retail and some other units; RELIANCE Industries Limited Debt-free; Global rating agency Moody's has downgraded the rating of automobile company Tata Motors; China and India are the 2 countries in the Asia Pacific region where the highest insurance policy has been purchased during the period of the Covid-19 epidemic; After China's action in Ladakh, Boycott's Demand of Chinese Items is increasing in the country; ICICI bank has sold 3.96% stake in its insurance branch, ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited for Rs 2,250 crore; Global funds have reduced their stake in India's Corporate Bonds. This may increase the liquidity problem of domestic companies facing economic challenges; Integrated net profit of Care ratings fell 57.2% to Rs 15.68 crore in the Quarter ended 31 March 2020; Tata Power has acquired a contract to develop a 100 MW solar project in Maharashtra.
